original: OK you Apes, listen up! I can't say when this war with the Bugs will end -- that's up to Terran Command. But the war on Kwalasha... it ends today, and it's up to us. This is the final showdown.
5th division is providing support. They’ve got penal battalions mixed in with them, so we’ll have to put up with those criminals and deserters on our flank while we push uphill
Intel says the brain bug is holed up in a cave system on top the mountain. Drive up on the right and pry that sonufabitch out into daylight.
Capture it alive, kill every other bug on this hill. You get me?
Once we have broken through the outer ring of hives, we will push north and establish a new base in the abandoned outpost across the river.
Here they come! Bugs bursting out of the ground!
I see this ambush as a positive sign. If the Brain Bug is willing to risk exposing itself in that fashion, the Bugs' situation must be desperate.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You’re welcome, ma'am. And thank you for pulling our asses out of the fire.
Colonel Hawthorne? What are you doing here?
It’s Private Hawthorne now. 16th Penal Battalion. Command offered me an Other than honorable discharge but I couldn’t sit around doing nothing, not while people were dying – so I re-enlisted.
Good to hear your voice again… private.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You should know, your former CO, Samuel Hawthorne was among them.

Command gave him the option to retire, instead he took a demotion to keep on fighting. Couldn’t sit idle while the MI was still marching into danger. Private Hawthorne was reported KIA during your ascent.
He didn’t need saving. He died with his troops, a hero of the Federation. It’s what he wanted.
The Brain Bug is in the open! Man, that thing is ugly!
You realize this reeks of a trap.
When it comes to the Bugs, colonel, everything reeks. But we're going to be ready for them.
The brain bug has been detected to the north. This time there can be no escape
OK, surround the area, then get in there and finish this.
Remember, the Brain Bug must be captured alive and unharmed. The scientists will be glad to have a fresh specimen, but their investigative methods can be quite... robust.
Flanking division’s getting overwhelmed. 5th division, come in, what’s the situation?
We’re getting chopped up pretty bad here, Colonel.
Roger that. Do you need support?
You know how this works. Every bug on us is one less standing in your way. Get up that hill and finish the job.
Officers are all dead. We’re all that’s left. We’ll hold them as long as you need. Over and out . . .
Last turret has been deployed.  No way the Bugs are taking back this bit of Kwalasha.
Wavebreaker turrets are being sent down to secure the area we've taken.
Secure the other Wavebreaker deployment locations and we can make this sector Bug proof.
Thank you.  It does make for quite a sight, doesn't it.
I'm just glad I'm not going to be the one to have to polish it up afterwards
FedNet is broadcasting the final assault. They'd like some footage of the Honor Guard Marauders on the battlefield.
Aren't they just for parades and ceremonies?
While these carry thinner armor than the production Marauders, the Honor Guard pilots are the cream of the crop. But they do mostly just look good on film.
If they think it's going to help, then we'll see what we can do.  But it can't get in the way of winning this fight
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
The fleet is bringing in more supplies as fast as they can.
Supplies have been delivered, more are coming soon.
All supply depots have been filled up!
The TAC Fighters have arrived. I hope you like the smell of roasted bugs!
Fleet will commence bombing runs to weaken the final hives. Stay out of the fire zone and time your advance accordingly.

In order to permanently eliminate the Arachnid threat on Kwalasha, we must burn the bugs out of their underground colonies. All major hives must be located, assaulted and eradicated.\n\nThis dangerous task will now be undertaken by our troopers in the Delta IV sector, where several bug holes have been detected along a vital highway.
Position your troops on the canyon heights and slaughter the bug attack.
Deploy a Command Center and 2 Sniper teams
Reposition HMG Turrets at the road crossing
Command has identified numerous bug holes in the area and guess whose job it is to clean ’em out.
Get your squads over to the supply base Asap and we’ll go from there. Move out!
Radio station up ahead. We should be able to cut through this interference and get some reinforcements.
OK call HQ and get another squad dropped on this position. We’re going to need all the help we can get.
OK the bugs are down. Get a squad in that bug hole to seal it up. They’re going to take some casualties, but that’s what we’re here for.
We can keep killing them, but they’ll keep coming until we seal those bug holes.
The first bug cave is nearby. Get over there and take it out.
Orders are to expand your foothold in the sector. Capture the local Radio Stations to use them as staging points for operations to take out Arachnid colonies.
Command has allocated you additional resources to fortify the outpost against Arachnid attacks.
Guess we're going to have a busy day at the office then . . . Alright, we're gonna need Combat Engineers and MG Turrets.
Get those Engineers earning their pay. We need two MG turrets covering the outpost before Archie comes to crash this party.
Those MG's aren't getting enough action back there. Get them disbanded and then redeploy them up at the bridge.
I prefer a one-way shooting arrangement with Archie, and those Spitter bugs complicate things. Get some snipers deployed and take 'em out before they get in range.
Sir, satellite surveillance has picked up major bug movement approaching your position. You don’t have long.
OK you heard the news. Our only chance is to use this valley as a kill zone. Use everything you got – if we don’t hold them here, we’ll all be dead anyway.
The bugs are here. Look sharp troopers!
Cease fire! They're all dead. Let's mop up this mess and call it a day.
We've failed.  Can't complete the mission now...
Bugs inbound. Find a firing position, people. Use the high ground.
Here they come again. Get those MGs firing.
Sir, HQ on the net. They’re asking why the area isn’t cleared yet.
Affirmative. But we have been a little busy here...
There is a radio tower ahead of your position.
Get up that slope and bring that station online.
Snipers! If it spits, it dies! Leave the rest of the uglies to us.
Send a unit into the Bug Hive
Position on the high ground to fire over the allied unit.

Move closer to the Hive to lure out bugs faster

We've secured another drill. One more to go.
Nothing like a mine to make you appreciate the desert...
Some seismic disturbance was picked up yesterday, then the line went dead. Third squad’s gone in to have a look and we’ve heard nothing since.
It’s probably just another rockfall messing with comms again – but let’s do this by the book anyway.
Turns out the whole sector is crawling with bug tunnels. The drill shafts must have broken into them and all hell's broken loose.

If we get the drill heads running again, they can mince up a whole lot of bugs down there.  Might buy some time for the people upstairs, because the shit is going to hit the fan when these bugs reach the surface.

Damnit. Control room door is locked.
We've got to get to that terminal to hack the lock.
There's the security terminal. Get on it.
Watch out! Bugs coming out of the supply tunnel.
We're going to have to hold here until the security gate's unlocked. Warm up everything you've got...
You've got the ammunition caches. I want those turrets positioned A-SAP!
As my old CO used to say, there's no such thing as bringing too many guns to a bug fight. Commandeer those ammo caches and get some MG turrets up.
We crushed a hell of a lot of bugs, but there’s lots more where they came from. Let’s get topside.
Shit, that is a ass-load of bugs. We don't have the firepower to chew through that lot before they chew through us.  We've got to get topside and let Command know what's going on down here.
Hold it. There's a whole load of bugs in the room up ahead. We're gonna have to think about how to handle this.
Third squad is still alive! Pleasant surprise. We can take the Bugs in a pincer movement...
Stay on guard. Now and then, there are stray bugs hiding down here…
This place is a goddamn maze.
Where’d all these bugs come from? We gotta warn HQ.
Do not lose the Tactical Officer
Do not lose the Tactical Officer

Bugs made a mess of the Kwals' attempts to defend this base, we're here to do a better job of it.
The flyboys report some serious bug activity out to the East.
Our mission is to get these miners back into their holes, not to go play in the dust with Archie. We'll ice them as they come at the walls.
Organise your defences and call down some extra bodies. Keep those bugs outside the walls, Lieutenant!
Be advised, another major bug attack is coming in from the East.
Engineers, set up HMG turrets. Pronto!
I smell trouble. Get this base ready for what’s coming.
We’re sending the first group of miners into shaft 1.

We need more time, damn it.
There’s been an incident... at the mine.
Oh, was it bugs? The bugs I said were definitely down there?

Clear the site of bugs, try to minimize disruption to the mining operation.
Alright, that Mining Shaft is operational again.
There's three others around here that Command wants up and running ASAP.
Grab any materiel caches you can find! We need that equipment to keep the Bugs out of our base.
Use whatever materiel we have available to strengthen our base defenses!
Intelligence reports that there are Kwal Comm bases nearby, used to provide logistical support to the mines.
Command is collecting eager volunteers to operate those mines, but those bases are needed for dropship insertion.
You heard the officer. Get a scouting party together and start getting those bases back online.
We're going to need to reinforce those units in the mountains. Call in some Radio Operators to help out.

The Bug hordes have been driven out of the capital and will be kept out of the industrial heartland through a solid barrier of fortifications.\n\nThe last section of this ambitious perimeter is about to be completed as the Mobile Infantry reclaims an abandoned line of defenses and gun batteries.
Do not lose any SAM Site
Bugs on the run?  Feels like this fight isn't quite over yet.
People at home need hope.  FedNet tells them what they have to hear to keep them fighting.
The perimeter will have to be retaken and its heavy weapons made operational.
That's not happening until we've cleared this rear area of bugs.  Then we'll push up and get those guns firing.
Thanks for the heads up.  We'll use the Perimeter's turrets to stop them.  Nothing's getting past those bad boys once they're up and running.
Excellent work. The perimeter is secure.  The remnants of the Arachnid forces are retreating into the desert.
As expected, the Bugs don’t relent so readily. Large numbers are closing on your position.
Looks they want to test the strength of these Wavebreakers. We’ll be ready for them.
Hold the perimeter, or the green zone is going to turn red real fast.

original: Bugs are holed up tight inside the power station.  Gonna be a real nightmare to pry them outta there.
Point taken, Colonel, but your mission is to root out the bug infestation and secure vital machinery around the facility.
Initial priorities are the damaged power turbines.  They'll have to be repaired by your combat engineers - but getting to them won't be easy.
There are three possible insertion points for your force: The Northwest, in front of the main entrance...
... to the east, at the end of the dam...
... or to the south, by the storage tanks. The team on the ground has to make the call on how to proceed.
Command is asking for a progress report.
We've just got one turbine up and running.  Moving to the next one now
You might have to pick up the pace.  Brass is feeling the pressure.
OK OK, we'll step on it.
The tech heads here report enough turbines are operational.  Good job.
OK, we'll start the battle from here.  Get some Engineers out to those turbines.  We need them up and running.
The center of the power plant is secure!
The core temperature has reached critical levels! Meltdown is imminent!

Heat signatures from the center of the station indicate the power core is starting to overheat. It must have been damaged when the bugs breached the facility. You have to reach it before the reactor goes into meltdown!
Intel reports a large scale bug infestation in the center of the power station. You'll need to muster a strong force to clean that up.
Intel shows a security building here. If you recapture it, we can gain access to the facility's security cameras.
It would be useful to know what we're sticking our noses into
Security center's ours.  I've got cameras are coming online now
Intelligence calculates that the Bug forces have been sufficiently weakened.  You're instructed to concentrate on the remaining mission objectives.
The bugs are getting pretty pissed. We have to take out those bug caves and cut down their numbers.
Understood. Command is allocating extra resources to your strike force.
These big Tiger bugs sure are tough bastards.  We're gonna need some heavier firepower to punch through.
Request's been granted.  Troopers armed with Morita IIs are dropping now.
Get an ammo dump set up to support deployment of these squads.
Great work. Station is back up and running and power's being restored as we speak. Instructions are to leave any Bug stragglers to the follow up crews.
That's the best news I've heard all day. I'm going to get me a hot shower and a cold beer - not necessarily in that order
Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Construct turrets in the center to suppress the bug tunnels!
Command didn't give us enough troops to keep the whole sector secured. Use gun turrets to support both defensive and offensive operations.
Are you sure you want to deploy around the selected Comm station?

Many were led astray by this criminal mastermind.

Kwalasha demands justice. This planet has no room for troublemakers.
If you’re not with the Federation, you’re with the bugs.

We’re neck deep in bugs here.

We have lost control over the prison!

20 minutes til showtime. They’re broadcasting the execution live on all channels.
Think I’ll skip this one. I see enough death in the field.
You’ve been assigned to prison defense. Keep that place locked down tight. Command doesn’t want anything interrupting the broadcast.
Ok troopers, we’re prison guards for now! Get on those walls.

Bug attack wave on its way.  Get your teams ready.
Do not lose the prison Radio Station

original: This whole damn area must be riddled with Bug tunnels. We've got hives popping up amid our forward outposts.
It's a complete shitshow out here. I haven’t seen this many bugs since Big K.
Clever bastards, waiting down there all this time, building their numbers.
But they won't get past the guns of Fort Meru.
Outer defenses will get hit first.  Make 'em pay for every inch of ground.
Command has recognised the forward supply depots are too vulnerable.
Fleet will begin transferring these supplies to the checkpoint base just in front of Fort Meru.
First wave? How many more bugs can we look forward to?
Do you really want an estimate?
Fleet has dropped extra supplies near the checkpoint base.
Command admits they may have underestimated the strength of the bug surge. All supplies will be transferred into Fort Meru's depot just in case the outer defenses cannot hold.
Scorpions! Those are gonna be trouble...
Deploy rocket launcher turrets, that's the best weapon we have against Scorps! \n
Another bug hive has been detected on west our flank. We’ve gotta collapse some of those caves and cut down their numbers.
Fleet has established a new supply depot in the second line. This position should suffice to hold any further Arachnid attacks.

As the most senior officer still on the ground, you've been put in charge of Fort Meru's communication stations and defenses. The Wavebreaker gun batteries should have no trouble obliterating the remaining bug hordes.
Wavebreaker crews, focus your fire on Scorpions! They’ve burnt enough holes in our \ndefenses already…
Bugs have tunneled right up to the front walls!  They're right on us!
We've got to hold the line here.
Dropships have arrived with extra supplies and munitions. They will remain on standby to deliver reinforcements.
Alright, let's get some more boots on these walls!
We need more guns and troopers to carry them if we are to hold this fort!
Hang in there. Dropships are already on route to bring more supplies and munitions.
They better get here fast. In the meantime we'll make do with what we have!
All supplies have been extracted from the outer bases and shifted to Fort Meru.
Evacuation is about 50% completed. Hang in there!
All non-combat personel has been evacuated. Get out of there Sam.
Everyone who is still fighting, fall back to the dropships! Get out of here while you're still in one piece!
No more Bugs in sight. Is it over?
Unfortunately, no. Bugs have broken through at multiple points and are now concentrating all their strength on Fort Meru.  It seems inevitable the base is going to fall.
Then we have to evacuate all remaining personnel... Get as many people out as you can.
Everything is falling apart, we're getting slaughtered out here!
The Arachnids have launched a vicious attack under the cover of a volcanic ash storm. Reinforcements are impeded, and Fraser's mercenaries are the only force in the sector available to stem the tide.
Do not lose the Fleet Beacon
Construct 2 HMG Turrets in the Processing Plant

original: Bugs, coming at us from everywhere! It's like they were waiting for us!
Problems, Director? We just cleared out another Bug hive, and now all I'm hearing on the radio is your people calling for help.
For every action, there's a reaction. These hive purges must have provoked the Arachnids, and now they've overrun several facilities.
So why don't you just call in your new Mobile Infantry buddies?
I can't bring in any reinforcements while this ash storm is happening.
So you're stuck with us, huh? Okay, we'll clear those areas and get your people out of there....but it's going to cost you extra.
The facility’s ahead of you. You need to clear it of Arachnid infestation.
And you need to move faster. We're tracking another approaching ash storm.
There it is! The processing plant!
Gunfire from it! Some of our people are still holding out there!
Come on! Let's help them out!
Patel, you there? Storm's over, the skies are clear, and you owe us a whole bunch of bonus payments.
Understood. I'm sending Mobile Infantry reinforcements to your position now.
Let's show these M.I. new arrivals how we kill Bugs in the private sector!
You can stand down now, Fraser. I'm sending Captain Zhao and further Mobile Infantry forces to take over from you and your people.
The dropships will bring you back to the station.
You serious? Pack up and let the Feds take over, when the battle isn't done yet?
The Mobile Infantry are a highly skilled military force--
--yeah, and they don't cost you anything. Unlike us.
I've made my decision. Return to the station...
...and need I remind you of the clause in your contract about the penalty for disobeying company directives being the forfeiture of all bonuses?
The mercenaries started this Bug battle, but we'll show them how to finish it.
Get ready to repulse the Arachnid assault!
Processing plant secured, ma'am. The Bug infestation here has been eradicated.
Excellent work, captain. I knew it was the right decision to bring you and your people to help us on Gehenna.
Okay, let's turn this place into a fortress. Bugs are gonna be on us any moment!
Remember, we're on our own here, until that storm clears!
Movement! Something coming at us out of cover of the ash storm!
Ash storm's easing off. At least now we can see what's coming at us.
Good news. The ash storm is passing over. You're free to call in reinforcements.
Someone get on that biped! It's what we need to take on these Immolator Bugs!
Fraser - receiving reports of a large Arachnid horde west of your current locale.
Any update on reinforcements for us?
Dropships still can't fly through the ash storm. You're on your own.
Confirmed. Get ready - that Arachnid horde is heading straight for you.
You and your people are well paid, Fraser. This is where you earn it.
Watch out! Bugs coming at us from two directions!
We gotta keep moving! If we stop, they'll surround and swarm us!
Keep going through them! The processing plant's just ahead!

original: Stay together, until we know the situation here.
Fall in. We're not here for R&R!
The control room. Let’s hope someone has answers for us here.
The alert's locked the security doors, but we can open them at that computer panel.
Bugs?! How did they get on board?
Company mercenaries? If they’re here, why does HephaeStar Corp need us
Captain Zhao? I'm Director Patel. Please gather your troops, and meet me in the control room.
The great Vilon Station, where “commerce and industry meet”. They certainly sell it better on the ads.
A security alert? What's happening here?
What kind of shoddy security operation are HephaeStar running here!?
Mercenary rabble. That explains a lot.
Everyone here? Then maybe Director Patel can tell us about her Bug problem.
Captain Zhao, you've arrived just in time--
There are Arachnids on your station, ma'am. I’ll need to call this in to Terran Command.
That won’t be necessary, Captain. I have a more urgent concern right now. There are fires that have broken out on the maintenance levels
I was reliably informed that you would be up to any task thrown at you, Captain. That is what the Mobile Infantry does, is it not?
Good. I have a firefighter crew on standby. They'll handle the flames. I need you to keep them protected.
More Bugs! How are they getting onto the station?
We'll investigate that later. Right now, I need those fires put out.
Hey fellas, open this door for us? We'll handle whatever's in there.
Keep walking, Fed man. You didn't see this.
Pacified Arachnids? What are they doing down here?
I want answers, but right now this station's safety is our priority.
More Bugs coming out of the vents!
We're fighting the fires. And the Bugs. They turned the room ahead into a bit of an inferno.
I'm sending you another team of firefighters. Make sure they stay protected.
The danger isn't over. Temperature levels are still high in the waste processing center.
You want us to help you deal with burning garbage? What about your mercenaries?
The Sky Marshal ordered you to fully cooperate, captain. Please do so.
Our waste incinerators. They must be attracted to the heat. You have my permission to destroy the machines if necessary, captain.
We don’t need permission to kill Bugs.
Careful! Bugs could be hiding in this smoke.
Let's show these civilians how the Mobile Infantry gets the job done.
*cough* My people can barely breath in here!
That level is directly above our nuclear reactor. If fire damages the cooling system...
Releasing enough radiation to render this station uninhabitable. So please hurry, captain.
All fires extinguished. Thank you, captain. You and your people are to report to the cargo bay.
The station's secure again. You can continue your deployment to Gehenna.
I saw Bugs under the control of your mercenaries. What exactly are you people doing here?
Did the Sky Mashal brief you on any classified operations being conducted here, captain?
Then that's because he decided you don't need to know. You're here to follow my orders and kill Bugs. Understood?
Troopers! Gear-up and board your boats. We're going down to the surface!

All Arachnids on the surface of Mahanagar’s central district have been eradicated. The Brain Bug, trapped in its underground lair, now faces its retribution amid the remnants of its minions.\n\nVerhaegen and Keys descend together, knowing this will be the last battle. The fall of the Brain Bug will signify the ultimate triumph over the Arachnid invasion.

original: The Brain Bug is sending an attack our way. It aims to slow us down!
Then tell the wrinkle-sack he's only delaying the inevitable. We're still comin'!
Let's hunt down and kill this blasted Brain Bug!
Y'know I'd normally agree, but Fed Intel ain't going to be happy if their favorite lab pet arrives to them in pieces. New orders are for capture.
After all this, we're letting that damn thing live?!
Trust me, when it comes to Fed Intel, there's a hell of a lot worse for a Bug than death...
Bravo and Charlie teams are held up in their sectors. Let's help our boys out and catch the Bugs in a pincer!
You got a read on where this slug is cowering yet?
I'm trying...but it's managing to block me out while we're this close.
Then we'll have to do this the old-fashioned way. Let's get to the nearby security center and get on the district cams.
You could have lived today, you ugly sack. I had a friend that tried to protect everyone.
One life or a hundred, it didn't matter to her -- everyone was worth saving all the same.
...but even she wouldn't protect your wrinkly ass.
Command, this is Major Verhaegen. It's over.
Send in cleanup with my exfil. The target didn't make it -- nasty sucker tried to fight back.
Here we go. Not even our cowardly slug friend can hide from Fed Intel's all-seeing eye.
The best protection the Federation has for its citizens is to know exactly what they're doing.
Those...people.... Has it sucked their brains out!?
Brain Bugs are more than just an ugly face.
'Bout time we hunt the bastard down and let Fed Intel give him worse in return.
Water! The Brain Bug is going to flood the whole underground!
A blasted trap! Argh! We need to get out!
No! I can stop this! I can stop the Brain!
I can get us through this... one more time!
We can't risk it Keys! I need to get you and my men out!
This is the Brain's last gambit! I can't let it win now! I... can... stop... this!
You can't always do it all, Keys! Sometimes you pick the battle, or you pick your people.
I'm taking your lead for once and choosing protection! Get! Out!
Got it! Water mains shut down! Ha!
See, Major? I knew I could do this. Now let’s go get that --
Goddamn it, Keys! Don't die on me!
Come on, kid, don't give up. You're tougher than this!
I want every last Bug in here put down for good.
Send all you want at us, Brain Bug. We'll kill them all the same!
You ain't making it much further, Marauder. Keep this zone locked down instead.
Ah, good to have a Marauder make it in with us!
Not a chance it'll fit anywhere down these tunnels.
No, but it'll sure scare the hell out of our slug friend some more, for now.
The Brain Bug wants us hunted down. Attackers moving through the tunnels, fast!
More Bugs! They ain't about to stop us now!

original: Hmm -- I'll save the rooting for later, Major. Bugs on the way!

Seems your lil' "intuition" show has impressed some of my bosses at Intel, Keys. I don't know how you've been missed as a psychic all these years, but it's sure saving me a few scrapes on this op, anyway.
Fed Intelligence are watching, huh? That got you worried that you might one day be saluting me, Major?
More the idea that you or those cranks might be rooting around inside my head. Never have warmed to that...
They're all over us! We're done for!
Don't die on me now, Keys! Keys!?
Goddamnit! Our flyboys missed their mark on the bridge out of the district.
Fleet's screw-up gives the Bugs free reign to keep on coming.
Best we can do for now is contain them by raising the drawbridges...
... while our cop buddies keep the highway locked down. We'll find a way to fix this mess after that!
One less bridge for the Bugs to use.
That's the Bugs cut off from the drawbridges. Now to kick the rest of 'em back into the Ganda.
Save some for us -- we're packing up and heading to you.
We've pushed across the first bridge, Keys. We'll close up shop behind us to ease the attacks on your end.
Let's keep raising the bridges all along the canal, troopers.
Bug nests burned. Now to raise the remaining drawbridges and keep it that way.
Won't be much use closing the island if we leave Bug Hives lying around. Let's clear them out!
Plasma Bug in the AO! We'll catch hell trying to fight under its bombardment.
Bring up the Cyclones. The M.I.'s newest toy will be able to rush its position with ease!
All Wavebreaker batteries set. Better get runnin', Bugs!
It's about time we turn the tide of this thing. Get a couple Wavebreaker batteries up and really show the Bugs who they're messing with!
Of course... the last bridge has no damn power! It'll need rebooting from the nearby power station.
Bombs planted -- everyone off the bridge!
Sorry, Bugs. This island is closed to ugly suckers -- find some place else to stay!
The sector is secured. Now, time to finish the job our flyboys left behind.
Bring up the techs -- we're blowing this damn bridge to hell ourselves!
Plasma Bugs! We shouldn't be hanging around in their range anyway -- just get the explosives down!
Argh... there it is again... Do Fed Intel ever teach you how to get used to this?
You better not be in my head, Keys!
It's worse than whatever you've got bouncing around in there, Major. Something nasty is lurking in that plant...
Then I s'pose I should introduce myself properly...
Come on out you ugly son of a--!
--whoa! Whatever stink-hole the Bugs dredged you up from, you took half of it with you!
Don’t let those stinkin' Bugs bully us back! Get some turrets down and show 'em proper firepower!

Ha. I'd expect no less, soldier. Gimme tabs on our slug friend, then. I wanna hear how he's screaming with every stinkin' Bug we crush!
Here we go, Brain Bug. Last place left to run, and the mighty fist of the M.I. is knocking on your door!
We'll restore order in the city center by first retaking Liberty Square from the bastards. They'll be forced to slink back to their Bug hole after that.
Liberty Square ain't going anywhere anytime soon now. Bring forward our firepower there for the final assault!
Bug attack incoming! Keep 'em out of the square!
We've handed the Bugs victory at Liberty Square with ease! Shameful conduct!
Liberty Square is free of Bug scum!
They'll be back in force, Major. The Brain Bug is getting desperate.
Good, cos' I've got plenty turrets to tear up anything it sends this way!
We can't give the Bugs time to regroup. Let's hit 'em hard now and wipe each sector of hives!
SAM sites up and firing. Tell Fleet they're welcome to start helping out now!
Fleet wants to send aerial support our way, but they won't while there are Bugs in the sky.
Figures that those flyboys want a shot at glory once the ball's on the one yard line already.
Fine, let's put up SAM sites and clear the skies for 'em.
All clear up here! Now just one last stinkin' Bug hole left to cleanse...
It's time to end this thing. The Brain Bug's responsible for the blood of thousands of innocents, all my friends, and the decimation of my city; I need to see its face when it dies.
You're almost sounding like a real soldier, Sergeant.
That's most of the city center cleared. The Bugs are all turning tail!
The Brain Bug is pulling everything to a final defense above its lair. I can feel him shaking; he's terrified of what's coming!
That's the first damn thing he's got right yet! We're coming to squash every last one of his dirty Bugs left!
Liberty Square ain't going anywhere anytime soon now. Bring forward our firepower there for the final assault!
Ha! If our slug friend wasn't scared before, he will be now -- Marauders are ready to join the fight!

original: The face at the end of it is even worse. Drones on the way!
You've proved handy 'til now, Keys. My team's in your charge -- lead the way.
It almost sounds like you're enjoying working with me, Major.
Heh. Don't push your luck, kid. Just get us through this.
Well then, Major, the main elevator should be accessible through this jail floor. It'll take us to the basement level.
More Drones incoming! Those turrets will thin the herd real good!
On the money again, Keys. Intel could really use an asset like you. How the hell were you not screened before?
Never had much time for all that, after dad died.
My intuition -- or, what I thought was just "intuition" -- is how I survived then, and hell, it's how I'll survive this too.
Elevator's a bust. What now, kid?
The Bugs must've had a way up here. If we just find their hole, we can get down.
That a hunch, or your intuition?
Let's just call it good old-fashioned cop work, Major. You gotta take some swings to make it in this line of work.
You “sensing” a quicker way down? Gonna take damn long doing this one floor at a time...
If you can manage a hike, there should be a stairway leading all the way to reception through this floor.
I'm not sure I want to know how some lowlife got his hands on heavy Fed tech, but he's done us a favor this time!
The station stashes any confiscated weaponry in a locker ahead, Major. Might be something useful for us.
Assuming your colleagues haven't already cleaned it out, then it's worth a look.
My god! They slaughtered half the station! I... should have been here...
Sorry, Keys, but you learn quick in this job that you can't save everyone all the time. I've been trying to get that through to you.
Best you can do is pick your battles where you can and swear payback for those left behind.
Saddle up, boys. We got a long way down.
Just the 30 floors to go. Can your M.I. keep up with my so-called "flatfoots"?
Mobile is in the name, you know...
Finally at reception -- I think my guys take that one, Major.
The elevator here can get us the rest of the way down now. Access to the sewer pumps is through the parking garage.
But we'll need to restore power to this floor first.
Hmph... I'm calling it a tie.
Bugs comin' in from outside! Block 'em out!
Power's running again. Let's get to the elevator.
Can't park here, Bugs. This spot's taken.
'Course -- more Bugs infesting the place. Clear 'em out and don't let 'em back in!
Bug nests cleared. You're up, Keys. Get us into the sewer.
Second pump activated! Thanks for the years of lectures, dad.
Welcome to the real Mahanagar -- the nerve center of the greatest city in the galaxy is ahead of you.
The city would sink without these water pumps regulating the mains system. Today however, they're also our best weapon against the Bugs.
Fed engineering -- it's a beautiful thing. Your daddy teach you all about this?
Despite my best efforts, yes. Overloading just three pumps should be enough to flood out the Bugs in the outer districts.
Then we'll have ol' wrinkle sack cut-off and wailing for support from his colony. Too bad most of 'em will be busy drowning...
'Bout time we get out of here. I'm in the mood to watch some Bugs drown back up top.
It will. You did damn fine here, Keys. Damn fine indeed.
That's the last pump done! This place will be flooded real soon!

Spiders, slugs, scorpions...you can keep making 'em as big as you want, I'll still stomp 'em down!
What the hell is that Bug!?

original: They ain't stopping... but neither do we, soldiers! Keep pushing!
Listen up! Bugs have breached the northern district and got the cops here struggling. You know what that means...
Those of you joining us for the first time will learn quick that Major Verhaegen's boys are the best Bug stompin' detail in the M.I.
Intel informs me we've got a large concentration of Bugs around the train lines. So our next stop, the railway station!
Uphold my sterling reputation, troopers. We're moving out!
Blast! Clearing them out caused the tunnel collapse.
We'll need to find a side way in over that rail line.
Bug nest ahead! We'll need to flush out that tunnel to get into the station.
Mobile Infantry? Finally, a bit of support.
You must be Officer Keys? Major Verhaegen, here to take over from you folks. This is M.I. business now.
Does "M.I. business" include getting our civilians evacuated out of the district?
My prime objective is killin' Bugs. But if that helps you complete the civilian evac, you can tag along.
That's good enough for me. Hives are this way.
Well I'll be... there's your Bugs, Keys. Getting real curious how you knew they were coming...
Just a cop with good intuition. What else do you expect me to be?
Aw hell. The cop might have been right...\n
Keys? I'm tracking a massive Bug horde on its way to you. We're also getting reports right across the city too!
I'll give it to you this time, your "intuition" might have been on the money. This is big.
I'll take my apology in the form of some back up for that horde!
All civvies packed away -- we're clear.
We're needed elsewhere, Keys. The situation is spiraling fast. I understand that this is your district, but I got a feeling you might be a real help, so if you're wanting to--
--I'm with you, Major. Let's hunt some Bugs.
Not bad, for flatfoots. Now, if you'll clear out our way, we'll be taking it from here.
We're not going anywhere until every last civilian is on a train out of the district. Is "protect and serve" not a part of the M.I. mission too?
The protection part of my job is clearing out Bug infestations. I'm better served stompin' out the problem before it spreads to more of your people.
You'll still be leaving these people here at risk! I can sense more Bugs on their way!
Fine. We'll hold. It's a good spot to thin the herd anyway. If there is one...
The civvies are in trouble! We signed up to protect them!
This is a disgrace to the badge! We have failed in our duty!
Civilians coming in for evac. Help them out!
Finally, some proper Bug huntin'! Onto the next one!
We've done what you asked, but it's time we shipped off to the next hive.
The Bugs will regroup before long. They've got a Brain Bug corralling them, Major. Was my report passed down?
The sewer sighting? Heh. Yeah. I could see how waste might be mistaken for one of them ugly suckers.
Take this seriously, Major! This attack is not the same as the usual outbreaks.
If you let me get on with my job it will be. Quashed and forgotten, just like the rest. We're moving, soldiers!
Tiger Bugs! We need more firepower for these nasty suckers.
Whoa... Fed Intel was on the money with the brief on Burster Bugs being here. Man, they're ugly bastards!
Bugs on the flank! Tear 'em apart!
Good to see boot camp is still feeding me capable soldiers. Let's push on to the station.
Use all this materiel to put up more defenses!
Why are we not putting all that materiel to use?! Deploy more turrets!

original: First shipment of materiel has arrived.
About time. Let's see how smart the Bugs look in front of a gun turret...
That's weak, troopers! You've let the Bugs overrun us!
Damn Bugs! They suckered us into that Station and spread out behind our backs. Ain't this city supposed to be better equipped for attacks!?
Governor Govac has repeatedly ignored the city's pleadings for more protection. Seems the Bugs were smart enough to exploit his failings.
Bugs' got plenty in common with some of our dear politicians, so that ain't surprising. Only had the pleasure of hearing one of 'em squeal when you fill 'em with lead, though.
Easy, Major. The Governor promised to bring us more Materiel, but it's not going to get here all at once. We'll need to keep an eye out for when more arrives.
There's more of your noncommies out the way, Keys.
The sector is getting too hot round our civilians. Speed up the evac!
You may not put much into "Protect and Serve", but I do! We've failed our people!
There's civilians still stuck in the sector. There's little point in any of this if we're not helping them out, Major!
Damn it! This ain't what the M.I. are trained for.
Best I can spare is a couple units to run shield for you -- I prefer my troopers on the frontline.
Hell. The Bugs are flanking us through the sewer pipes!
All of Mahanagar is interconnected through those pipes -- even under the canals. If an infestation has taken root in there, we could be in real trouble.
Bugs rolling around in stinkin' muck, huh? Figures.
Not so, in this case. Mahanagar is built on the most high-level maintenance system in all of the Federation, thanks to engineers like my father.
Then I hope his life's work can withstand a frag or two. We've gotta flush out those hives.
Something's... happening... elsewhere in the... city...
Head in the game, Keys! We need you here and now!
There certainly is, soldier. In front of you! So pick up your rifle and get fighting!
Ah hell! I need you with me back in the real world, Keys. We MUST hold on.
That's weak, troopers! You've let the Bugs overrun us!
The shelling has got our flanks running for cover!
That's weak, troopers! You've let the Bugs overrun us!
Blasted cowards! Command is calling for a "tactical withdrawal". It's getting worse across the city!
And what comes of the civilians still stranded here? One life or one hundred -- I'm not leaving 'til we save all we can.
Not mission priority I’m afraid... but I'll see if I can get Fleet to step up with more drop ships. And I ain't going anywhere either, Keys!
The Bugs are flooding the sector!
That's all she wrote, troopers! Fall back with the noncommies across the bridge, unless you fancy joining tonight's Bug feast.
Bugs incoming on the flanks! I just received another batch of materiel. We’ll use it to give your civvies cover, Keys, but we can't stay forever.
Keys - We can't hold much longer...
These people still need us here!
We’ll all die if we stay. I know it's tough, but we need to prep our retreat while we still can!
Dropship's away! Everyone else, run for the bridge!
And tell 'em to double time it! I'm not dying here 'cos noncommies could only manage a jog!
They don't teach tact in the M.I., do they?
They teach tact-tics, Keys. Tact ain't ever helped tear a Bug to pieces.
The Bugs are all over our civilians. Help them!
We're letting good people be slaughtered! Have we abandoned our duty?!
You may not put much into "Protect and Serve", but I do! We've failed our people!
A single ship!? The Federation suffering from cutbacks too now!?
Those Fleet cowards probably don't want to risk any more of their precious ships if it ain't part of their primary orders.
The rest of the civvies will just have to walk. And we will go with them...
Whoa now! Keep our defenses out the range of that Plasma Bug!
Plasma shelling! Brace, and keep on fighting, troopers!

original: A SAM site’s been knocked out! Get the techs here to get it firing again, ASAP!
First SAM is up. Let's clear them skies!
The flyboys better be thanking us -- 2nd SAM site has been deployed.
Another SAM site online -- one more should do it!
Looks like we're late to the party -- Police HQ is already crawling with Bugs.
And you're sure this is the best way down to the maintenance tunnels?
To keep us off the streets, yes. HQ will give us quick access into the heart of the water mains system. And candidly, I'd like to check on my colleagues, too.
It ain't looking too good from where I'm sitting, Keys, but we'll do our best to support whoever's in there.
Hear that, troopers! I want this station locked down with an AA ring all the way around these rooftops! Go!
We've failed to capture the Police HQ in time! The Bugs won't give us a second chance...
Excellent. My assault task force has arrived right on cue.
They will make their way to the police HQ and secure the comms satellite on the rooftop.
We've only got a small window for them to take control of the station's roof -- the Bugs will get wise soon!
We've wasted our shot to take the HQ! The Bugs have us nailed now!
You heard 'er, task force -- the op's counting on you to reach that roof in one piece.
Bugs are heading for the police HQ. Prepare the defenses!
The Bugs have reached the HQ. Fire at will!
Quit slacking, We need more turrets on that rooftop!
Argh! The roof is overrun! We're pulling out!
HQ roof secured! Now for the fun part.
The Bugs will stop at nothing to take it back. Hope you've got your defenses ready!
That did it! They're pulling back!
Hope our slug friend is hurting with that one. He's got worse coming once we get down to his level...
Then let's not waste any time. Follow me inside -- you're on my op now.
Ungh! I can feel it -- the Brain Bug isn't happy with that. The Bugs are sending everything this way!
Heh. Bring it on, skin-sack. Not one of your stinkin' Bugs is getting to this roof alive!
We've got Plasma Bugs covering the next SAM position. I'm trustin' in you flyboys to deal with that. Sic the Gunships on 'em!
Ugh. What's that awful buzzing sound?
Ah hell! Hoppers incoming! Keep low and blow those buzzards out the sky!
Plasma Grenadiers have got us zeroed! Cowards are just of range, too -- get the Gunships to hunt 'em down!
Missile turrets are now available for deployment. Position them on the police HQ to deal with Plasma Grenadiers!

original: Citizens of Mahanagar have nothing to fear thanks to the men and women of the MPD!
They control troublesome situations, like this one! A foolish robbery attempt, now in the hands of our capable police negotiator!
Easy on those trigger fingers, guys. There's a way out of this for everyone.
I’m Sergeant Keys. I’m here to make sure no one gets hurt.
Just let the hostages go, and I'll see to it that your concerns are heard by the Federation Judiciary.
I’m not holding anyone hostage! All I wanted was to cash out my war bonds...
This damn Bug War is taking forever - and they won’t give me my money back! I’ve got rent to pay - a family to feed!
I know life in Mahanagar can be a struggle, but hurting innocents isn't going to solve any problems.
I never meant to hurt anyone - I just need MY money!\n
What a mess. Clear the scene of civvies, now!
Scratch that -- radio is going haywire with more Bug reports in the district.\nWe've got to stop this from happening elsewhere tonight!
Come this way, people! We'll keep the Bugs off you!\n
Get those civvies secured. More Bugs rushing from the garbage belt!
The rest of the district needs to be warned to get off the streets. We can send an emergency broadcast from the radio station ahead!
It's... not ending... Just breakout after breakout across all radio channels.
Hope no one wanted an early night; we've got a lot more work to do.
I want the Peacekeepers out on the streets, stat.
Their tear gas launchers are effective for dispersing protesters; switching them for frag rounds will make quick work of any Bug.
Tankers!? Even the M.I. rarely see those brutes! This is serious! We'll need Riot Shield Squads!
This is definitely what I saw... but it feels more familiar than that...
I used to get in trouble as a kid for playing down here. Is that what I'm seeing now? But... Why?
Good job, team. Now let's re--
--argh... my head... What's... happening... to me...
Was that the underground? It felt like I was... there? And something else was with me...
I need to check it out.
A Brain Bug!? How is that... possible? This'll need to be called in right away. Many more lives are in danger!
Keep watch out here. I'm going in.
Dammit Kayla. What are you getting yourself into now...
Let's get back to the station, team! Federation brass need to know what's coming this way!
Here they are! Let them have it!
They're still coming! We have a duty to protect the civvies that came here for safety!
They just won't let up! Fire anything you've got left!
We'll only run down our ammo keeping the fight here all night!
Screw it. Get an emergency message to all civilians in the district -- we're opening an evac at the Railway Station.
I'm getting everyone off this damn island.
The Station is overrun! We're done for!
The Bugs are headed for the Police Station! Get up those walls!
Set all turrets to focus their fire on those Tigers!\n
Tiger Bugs spotted on the move. Get turrets on the wall to slow them down!
Civilians in trouble! Watch your fire this time!\n
Gunfire ahead! That must be our guys in need of help!
More of ours! Let's back them up!
Tanker!! Riot Shields, up front! Bring down that beast!

You want us to play bait? If that’s what it takes, that’s what we’ll do...
It's over for us down here, Major!
Don't die on me, Keys! We're nearly there!
Damnit, Major! Where are you! We're done for!!\n
Damnit, soldier! Don't give up now!
And the crowd's comin' runnin'! Bugs are clearing the airstrip and coming to you!
Make your landing quick then! We can only hold so long.
You think I'd leave you in the lurch? I'll be in to save your ass soon enough!

We'll work on taking that Flight Control room asap!

About time we had the numbers in a fight! We can begin clearing the starport now!
Starport secured -- the M.I. is back running things in Mahanagar.
Ol' wrinkle-skin best be quaking in his slug hole. We're comin' for him now.
Leave at least some of him left for me. My city has lost everything because of this blasted Brain Bug.
You'll get your shot, Keys. I'll see to that.
Rainmaker delivery -- now that's what this op's been missing!
Arm up and throw the last of these ugly suckers off my runway!
Operation "Kick Bug Ass" is officially back up and running!
